evidence: Carries the Utils/log/libs label and directly modifies logging core (src/logging.cpp) and string helpers (src/util/string.h) to handle newline escaping.
rationale: Prevents untrusted inputs from forging fake log lines across node logging. As shown in the PR description, unescaped newlines allow restricted RPC users or external inputs to inject arbitrary lines such as 'ERROR: ConnectTip: ConnectBlock ... failed' into debug.log, risking automated monitoring disruption and operator confusion.
